narrative: Anchorline Project Partners provides independent, technically-grounded site verification, quantity surveying, and project management services for clients building or investing in property across Nigeria, with particular focus on diaspora clients who cannot be physically present to supervise their own projects. We act as our clients' trusted, qualified eyes on the ground: verifying progress, auditing costs, and reporting honestly, so they can make informed decisions from wherever they are in the world.
approach: Honest reporting, without a relationship with contractors
Structured, written engagements rather than informal arrangements
credentials: Over half a decade of hands-on construction project management experience, including luxury residential and mixed-use developments
B.Eng., Civil Engineering, Federal University of Technology, Owerri (FUTO)
Practicing Project Manager, currently overseeing luxury residential and mixed-use developments
